purpose: Define the transport-neutral envelope accepted by the Rosetta Research Workbench canonical-read adapter without moving scientific semantic authority into the browser or repository.
authority_rule: Payload producers must read the canonical semantic owners. This contract validates transport, binding completeness, provenance resolution, and scientific-firewall invariants; it does not create or grade scientific truth.

accepted_transports.file_path: Current as-of export; never labeled live.
accepted_transports.file_uri: Current as-of export; never labeled live.
accepted_transports.https: Live canonical-read service transport when the returned bundle reports CURRENT authority.

required_binding_fields: at least one source locator: drive_id | spreadsheet_id | registry | github_repo | source
fail_closed_conditions: binding lacks semantic_owner or source locator
displayed record references unresolved provenance id
ZERO_SYNTHETIC software verification carries biological_evidence other than false
explicit_non_goals: Direct Google Drive authentication or synchronization
